lines.text: Damn it! It's not moving!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Come on! That's just way too big!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: On top of that, it's moving insanely fast! It just looks slow!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: That's because it's so large. It has the stride of a giant.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Honestly, I'm struggling just to keep up!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ziz! Can you fly up to her head?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-I think so...!
The top of the Goddess of Victory statue glows an eerie red.
I have to crane my neck to see it, but the light is clearly visible.
*Pshoom!*
The red light shoots toward the sky.
Soon, dozens... no, hundreds of red beams pour down overhead.
What's happening?!
*Boom! Boom! Boom!*
The red light pours down like rain, tearing the ground apart.
All we can do is scramble to avoid the barrage.
Meanwhile, the statue has gotten even further ahead.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-It's hopeless unless we can break through all this!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Very well. Then break through we shall. Bear me upon thy wings.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but... It's even more impossible if I'm carrying someone.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'll try to get closer!
Rapunzel's halo glows, and the red components begin to vibrate.
Rapunzel kicks off the ground and launches herself into the air, quickly closing the distance to the statue.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Incredible...!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow! She just hops around like a flea!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Of all things to compare her to...
Just as Rapunzel is about to land on a protruding part of the statue...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh dear...
*Boooom!*
Suddenly, as if pulled from below, Rapunzel plummets straight to the ground.
She scrambles to her feet.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: G-goodness gracious...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: If thou hast yet to grow accustomed to thy body, do not strain thyself so.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: It has a gravity field.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Pardon...?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: If you get close, it'll drag you downward.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But Snow White's attacks...
I turn my head to look at Snow White.
She's running parallel to the advancing statue, relentlessly unleashing her attacks.
She focuses all her fire on the statue's lower half, but it regenerates almost instantly.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Aye. It appears it doth simply bear attacks that its regeneration can overcome.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: It seems to be more wary of me, since my vibrating staff can disrupt the structure of the nanomachines.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Then it seems it doth not merely press forward, but is ever on its guard.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's not good. It's hard to approach her from the air with those destructive beams raining down, and she can regenerate, too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: On top of that, she can create a gravity field around her whenever she needs to? What can't she do?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She probably has more surprises in store for us.
... All right. Then let's approach it from underground.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Good thinking. We could drill through the ground, then make our way inside the statue...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ooh, that's a classic when going up against a giant boss.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... Please don't tell me we have to go crawling through a tunnel.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We should really keep our distance. We have no idea what's lurking under there.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If it's full of Dark Matter, we'd be dead before we even get a chance to do anything.
... Let's keep following it for now. We'll attack as we go.
Attack it from all angles. We might stumble across something that works.
Everyone nods before turning to attack the statue.
However, they all look doubtful.
I probably look just as doubtful.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We still can't get through to Eden or the Ark. Its jamming capabilities are strong enough to prevent short-range communications.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Judging by the way it keeps heading toward the Ark, it means business.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: It's pretty unusual for the final boss to barge into our base.
... For now, I think we should relay the intel we've gathered to the Ark.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It has plenty of mobility. Although...
Rapi looks up at the statue.
Its staggering height easily reaches three hundred meters.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ...The problem is, we'd have to turn our backs on it as we move.
... Let's just gather as much information as we can for now.
We'll make our way to the Ark when the opportunity arises.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Roger.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Report on the status of the Ark's power source.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Gah...!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Um, Ms. Enikk? I know you're all-seeing and all-knowing inside the Ark,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: but do you think you could stop popping up out of nowhere and casually striking up conversations?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's already tense enough around here without you scaring us half to death.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Y-yeah... You seriously scared me.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: You've done that several times lately, and I still can't get used to it.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: A-a little warning would be nice.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood. Next time, I will count down before initiating communication.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Uh... s-sure. I guess that's better than nothing.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Report on the status of the Ark's power source.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: As expected, the output has been steadily dropping.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Judging by its current rate, it'll fall below ten percent in the next forty-one days.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The minimum output required for the Ark's ascent is estimated at fifteen percent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Also, we expect preparations for it to be complete within a week.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Can you maintain the current output until then?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Y-yeah... It'll be close, but we'll figure something out.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: So the Ark really is going to ascend to the surface...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. The Ark's forces have been actively making preparation for this.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: ... That means we're actually going to get to see the sky.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Cool! Then, in the name of Electric Shock, we'll do whatever it takes to keep the output up!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: If you require any assistance, do not hesitate to ask. After all, this is the most critical element in the Ark's ascent—
*Vrooom*

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Uh... Is that sound coming from the power source?
*Vrooom*

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: What's... going on...?
Elegg starts fiddling with a machine connected to the Ark's power source.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: ... Ms. Enikk? Ms. Trony?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Its output just increased...?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Wait, it's getting higher...?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: N-no kidding. It's really increasing.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: That's weird.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Yeah, how strange.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: This thing's always losing efficiency. There's no way it would suddenly recover on its own.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: ... Ms. Enikk. Something's going on, isn't it?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You have total control over everything in the Ark, so something must have happened on the surface.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: A massive unidentified being emerged near the Lift and is now approaching the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Judging by its current speed, it's expected to reach the Ark within three days.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Wh-what being is it?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I'm still working on identifying it. There's a strong jamming signal that's preventing a detailed identification.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: ... Just how big are we talking?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It's estimated to be around three hundred meters tall.
Trony quickly works the controls of the machine connected to the Ark's power source.
*Vrooom*
Meanwhile, the power source emits an even louder roar.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: ... It's vibrating.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: It's vibrating ever so slightly, stirring up the particles inside and increasing the output.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Vibrating? I don't think it has a function like that...

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: It seems to be resonating with the waves coming from outside.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: The stronger the vibrations, the greater the output.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The fact that a massive being over three hundred meters tall can move means it must have a comparable power source.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: A typical Rapture core wouldn't be nearly enough.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Yeah. I can't be certain, but the power source must be equivalent to a gigantic core like the Ark's.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: ... Or maybe it is one.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Ms. Enikk, you said that giant thing is getting closer to the Ark, right?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: For whatever reason, that thing's power source is emitting its own unique waveform.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The Ark's power source is vibrating in response to that waveform, increasing its output.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The closer that thing gets, the stronger the vibrations and the higher the output. I think that's a safe assumption to make for now.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is a valid deduction.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Great. I have no idea what's going on, but this is good news. The Ark's dying power source is being revitalized.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: At this rate, we'll have more than enough power for the Ark's ascent!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: ... Not that anyone here is silly enough to think that!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: ... Yeah. This is dangerous.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: The vibrations are agitating the internal particles and increasing the output.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: That's a classic self-destruct sequence.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Once that gigantic thing gets within a certain distance of the Ark...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The Ark will go boom!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Y-yeah.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I have reached the same conclusion.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I have no idea why it even has such a function, but this is super mega bad news.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe. I knew it was a bad idea the moment we started relying on some mysterious power source.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Assuming it continues moving at its current speed, can you determine when the output of the Ark's power source will reach 100%?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: ... In two days.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: If that giant being or whatever it is suddenly speeds up, it could be even sooner.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Well then.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Let's drain this suddenly revitalized thing of its energy and keep its output from going up, shall we?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Y-yeah. That's all we can do for now anyway.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: We have to slow it down as much as possible.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Okay. Let's do this.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Oh, before we start, do you wanna go update your will first?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: No, that's okay.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: I'll make sure we pull this off.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe, great!
Inside the Central Government's main conference room...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Everyone, status report.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: There are no issues with the Ark's ascent systems. If we can just get enough power, we can proceed at any time.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: C'est difficile to find any reason not to proceed with la Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It looks like our concerts et promotions have been effective.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: How's la situation in the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: E.H. said things are in the final stages. It should be complete soon.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: How are things going on the Ark's end?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We've finished evacuating most of the citizens to the shelters.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: But there are some who are refusing to cooperate.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Why's that?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'm not sure. I suppose they each have their own reasons.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Still, we're planning to move them to the shelters by force. The process should be over soon.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Are there any issues or concerns?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: No. It just seems like you've changed overnight. My apologies.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... I don't have time to spare putting on an act right now.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Then the only remaining issues are the overly expanded additional facilities, as well as the elevators and the Dome of Eternity.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Demolition is going smoothly with the help of the Mighty Tools and Cafe Sweety, but time is of the essence.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: If we abandon our approach of preserving the Ark's integrity and pivot to prioritizing speed by sending in Endless and Eternity...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: the job can be completed today.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: In just a day? You've turned them into quite the monsters, huh?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To be clear, this only applies to the sections of the Ark that will ascend.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We plan to abandon all other areas.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... You're in a hurry.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. There's currently a significant problem with the Ark's power source.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We don't have much time.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Then, what's the scheduled date for the Ark's ascent?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Quoi?!

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What did you say...?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What...?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you think the Ark's ascent is as simple as hopping on an elevator and riding it up to the surface?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is a matter serious enough to warrant taking every possible risk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We cannot delay our ascent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please disseminate the file I've transmitted to the relevant Nikkes and departments, then expedite your operations.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Any issues that cannot be resolved by tomorrow morning...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We'll leave them unresolved and proceed with the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is what must be done.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Good. Let's speed things up, then.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I don't want to waste any more time on this meeting either. Let's adjourn, and everyone, please pick up the pace.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Bon... D'accord!

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... All right. I'll be on my way.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Seriously, I can't believe this. This isn't some stroll in the park, you know!
Everyone leaves the conference room.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What are our odds of failure?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I can't provide you with an exact number, but the likelihood is high.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: If we fail, is there a future for us?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... I see.
Burningum silently stares into space.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Whichever way this goes...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I guess this is the end.
